I replied to Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message: the main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals is Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

I used two sources Marcus can see himself. Dana posted in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025 that Thea had flagged the duplicate arrivals on door 6 (morning shift). The public North team cheat sheet also lists Thea as the main contact for Quarrendon Freight Lines. A contact name is an operational fact, so it's fine to share with the account's team.
